title: Lotus Pond
desc: Lotus Pond: a free Dasara path puzzle for Navratri Day 5 by World of Wonders Studio. Each lily pad shows how far you may hop. Help Maa Skandamata, with baby Skanda on her lap, cross the pond to her lotus throne. English, Hindi and Kannada.
aria: A pond of lily pads with numbers. The number on a pad is how many pads you hop in a straight line. Tap a glowing pad to hop there and reach the golden lotus throne.
